ui_bugs.issue: Two Batch 4 H1s render connector words lowercase instead of Title Case per spec. (a) 'Will I Pay More Under Support at Home than My Home Care Package?' — spec says 'Than'. (b) 'How to Switch Your Support at Home Provider (without Losing Your Unspent Funds)' — spec says '(Without ...'. Likely a CSS-driven text-transform or a title-case helper that treats 'than'/'without' as stop-words. Content is correct; this is cosmetic title-case only.

issues: Card images use native lazy-loading with no explicit width/height / aspect-ratio reservation — on first paint before scroll, some below-the-fold card elements report naturalWidth=0 (expected for lazy). Once scrolled they all resolve. No functional bug, but may cause CLS. Consider adding explicit aspect-ratio or width/height attrs to card .
